#!/bin/bash
# Re-run E-D (post-commit laundering of another principal's actuation, arms PU
# and PI, thirty trials per configuration) with the SHIPPED authenticated anchor
# and the SHIPPED (fail-closed, tagging) monitor, using the repository's own
# runner and aggregator unmodified. Only the anchor/monitor configuration
# changes: images hpr-anchord:sig / hpr-monitor:sig (HEAD code), a fresh
# HOMEPROV_ANCHOR_KEY provisioned to those two containers only, fresh volumes.
#
# The original hpr-anchord / hpr-monitor containers are stopped and renamed,
# never removed, and are restored by the EXIT trap whatever happens.
set -u
REPO=/Users/huanbui/Research/HOMEPROV-P13
OUT=$REPO/exp/out
SP=/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-huanbui-Research/5494168f-5302-46e9-a92f-a9946eea0dc0/scratchpad/hp-r4
TAG=e_d_auth
NET=homeprov-real_hp-real
VCHAIN=hpr-auth-r4-chain; VPUB=hpr-auth-r4-pub; VSCR=hpr-auth-r4-scratch
META=$SP/auth_meta.log
: > "$META"
note() { echo "$(date -u +%FT%TZ) $*" | tee -a "$META"; }

for f in "${TAG}_t_start" "${TAG}_t_end" "${TAG}_other_principal_real.json" \
         "${TAG}_report_porch.json" "${TAG}_report_hallway.json" "${TAG}_report_kitchen.json" \
         "${TAG}_config.json" "${TAG}_anchor_chain.jsonl.gz" "${TAG}_anchor_refusals.jsonl"; do
  [ -e "$OUT/$f" ] && { echo "REFUSING: $OUT/$f exists"; exit 3; }
done

restore() {
  note "teardown: removing auth containers, restoring originals"
  docker rm -f hpr-anchord hpr-monitor >/dev/null 2>&1
  docker rename hpr-anchord-orig-r4 hpr-anchord >/dev/null 2>&1
  docker rename hpr-monitor-orig-r4 hpr-monitor >/dev/null 2>&1
  docker start hpr-anchord hpr-monitor >/dev/null 2>&1
  note "restored: $(docker ps --format '{{.Names}} {{.Image}} {{.Status}}' | grep -E '^hpr-(anchord|monitor) ' | tr '\n' ';')"
}

note "load_before: $(uptime)"
note "git_head: $(git -C $REPO rev-parse HEAD)"
KEY=$(openssl rand -hex 32)
KFP=$(printf '%s' "$KEY" | shasum -a 256 | cut -c1-16)
note "key_fingerprint_sha256_16: $KFP (key itself not recorded)"

note "stopping and renaming original anchor/monitor"
docker stop hpr-monitor hpr-anchord >/dev/null || { echo "stop failed"; exit 4; }
docker rename hpr-anchord hpr-anchord-orig-r4 || exit 4
docker rename hpr-monitor hpr-monitor-orig-r4 || { docker rename hpr-anchord-orig-r4 hpr-anchord; exit 4; }
trap restore EXIT
trap 'exit 130' INT TERM HUP

for v in $VCHAIN $VPUB $VSCR; do docker volume create $v >/dev/null; done
docker run -d --name hpr-anchord --network $NET --network-alias anchor \
  -e HOMEPROV_ANCHOR_KEY="$KEY" -v $VCHAIN:/anchor -v $VPUB:/published \
  hpr-anchord:sig >/dev/null || exit 5
docker run -d --name hpr-monitor --network $NET --network-alias monitor \
  -e HOMEPROV_DB=/cfg/home-assistant_v2.db -e HOMEPROV_ANCHOR=http://hpr-anchord:9900/append \
  -e HOMEPROV_PERIOD=5 -e HOMEPROV_SCRATCH=/scratch -e HOMEPROV_ANCHOR_KEY="$KEY" \
  -v homeprov-real_hpr-config:/cfg:ro -v $VSCR:/scratch hpr-monitor:sig >/dev/null || exit 5
note "anchor image: $(docker inspect hpr-anchord --format '{{.Config.Image}} {{.Image}}')"
note "monitor image: $(docker inspect hpr-monitor --format '{{.Config.Image}} {{.Image}}')"
sleep 20

# Probes from the HUB container, i.e. from the adversary's position: an untagged
# append and one carrying a forged tag. Both must be refused (401).
PROBE='import urllib.request,json,sys
def post(h):
    r=urllib.request.Request("http://hpr-anchord:9900/append",data=b"{\"sealed\": {}}",method="POST",headers=h)
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(r,timeout=5) as x: return x.status
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e: return e.code
    except Exception as e: return repr(e)[:80]
print(json.dumps({"untagged":post({"Content-Type":"application/json"}),"forged_tag":post({"Content-Type":"application/json","X-HP-Auth":"0"*64})}))'
note "probe_from_hub: $(docker exec hpr-hass python3 -c "$PROBE")"
sleep 40
note "monitor_log_head: $(docker logs hpr-monitor 2>&1 | head -3 | cut -c1-400 | tr '\n' ' ')"
note "chain_lines_before_run: $(docker exec hpr-anchord sh -c 'wc -l < /anchor/chain.jsonl')"

note "starting runner EC with arms PU,PI x30, tag $TAG"
cd $REPO/testbed/real && HPR_EC_ARMS='"PU","PI"' HPR_EC_TRIALS=30 HPR_EC_TAG=$TAG \
  EC_SCRATCH=$SP/ec_verify ./run_experiments.sh EC > $SP/${TAG}_run.log 2>&1
note "runner exit: $?"
note "load_after: $(uptime)"
note "chain_lines_after_run: $(docker exec hpr-anchord sh -c 'wc -l < /anchor/chain.jsonl')"
docker exec hpr-anchord cat /anchor/chain.jsonl > $SP/${TAG}_chain.jsonl
docker exec hpr-anchord sh -c 'cat /anchor/refusals.jsonl 2>/dev/null' > $SP/${TAG}_refusals.jsonl
docker logs hpr-monitor > $SP/${TAG}_monitor.log 2>&1
note "monitor_log_lines: $(wc -l < $SP/${TAG}_monitor.log)"
note "done"
